title: The Lamplighters' Dread
text: The lamplighters refuse to work. Something follows them on their rounds, they say, and at the end of each night there is one more lamp lit than there are posts.

options.label: Pay the lamplighters double for the winter.

outcomes.text: The lamps burn. The extra one burns too, somewhere, every night.

options.label: Send your Scions out on the rounds with them.

outcomes.text: The Scions see nothing, but the lamplighters walk taller.
Your Scion comes back from the last round with burns on one arm, shaped like long fingers.
The city goes dark for a season. Doors stay barred, and the nights belong to something else.
